questions.question: Which is the largest species of cat in the world?
questions.hint: The Siberian (Amur) Tiger is the largest living cat species, with some males weighing over 300 kg.

questions.question: Which mammal can naturally hold its breath underwater the longest?
questions.hint: Cuvier's Beaked Whale has recorded dives lasting over 220 minutes, making it the longest breath-holding mammal known.

questions.question: Which film became the first animated movie ever nominated for the Academy Award for Best Picture?
questions.hint: Disney's Beauty and the Beast (1991) was the first animated feature nominated for Best Picture.

questions.question: Which actor portrayed Iron Man in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.hint: Robert Downey Jr. launched the MCU with Iron Man (2008) and became one of its defining stars.

questions.question: Which organization publishes the annual Human Development Index (HDI)?
questions.hint: The HDI measures health, education, and income to compare countries' development.

questions.question: Which day is observed globally as International Women's Day?
questions.hint: International Women's Day is celebrated annually on March 8.

questions.question: Which civilization first developed the concept of the Senate?
questions.hint: The Roman Senate became one of history's most influential political institutions.

questions.question: Which city was known as Byzantium before becoming Constantinople?
questions.hint: The city evolved from Byzantium to Constantinople and is now known as Istanbul.

questions.question: Which Grand Slam tennis tournament is played on grass courts?
questions.hint: Wimbledon is the oldest tennis tournament and the only Grand Slam still played on grass.

questions.question: In baseball, how many strikes result in a strikeout?
questions.hint: A batter is out after accumulating three strikes, unless specific exceptions apply.

questions.question: Which country contains the world's largest tropical rainforest?
questions.hint: Around 60% of the Amazon Rainforest lies within Brazil.

questions.question: Which is the highest active volcano in the world?
questions.hint: Located on the Chile–Argentina border, Ojos del Salado rises to about 6,893 meters (22,615 feet).

questions.question: Which SI unit measures electric current?
questions.hint: Electric current is measured in amperes (amps), named after André-Marie Ampère.

questions.question: Which planet has the strongest magnetic field in our Solar System?
questions.hint: Jupiter's magnetic field is approximately 20,000 times stronger than Earth's.

questions.question: Which country is home to the ancient temple complex of Angkor Wat?
questions.hint: Angkor Wat is the world's largest religious monument and appears on Cambodia's national flag.

questions.question: Which musical composer became completely deaf yet continued composing masterpieces?
questions.hint: Beethoven composed some of his greatest works after losing his hearing.

questions.question: Which insect is the strongest relative to its body weight?
questions.hint: The horned dung beetle can pull more than 1,000 times its own body weight.

questions.question: Which country has the world's longest railway network?
questions.hint: The United States has the world's longest rail network, extending over 250,000 kilometers.

questions.question: Which scientist formulated the three laws of planetary motion?
questions.hint: Kepler's laws accurately describe the elliptical orbits of planets around the Sun.

questions.question: Which empire constructed the famous road network known as the Royal Road?
questions.hint: The Royal Road was built under the Achaemenid Persian Empire to improve communication and trade across the empire.
